Knockout system Double elimination Group stage League Whoever loses a match is eliminated. The winners advance round by round until the final decides the tournament winner. If the number of participants does not fill a complete bracket, the top seeds get a bye into the second round. Your first loss sends you to the second-chance bracket, only the second one eliminates you. In the Grand Final, the winner of the main bracket meets the winner of the second-chance bracket. If the player from the second-chance bracket wins, a deciding match follows. From 3 players. Players are split evenly into 2, 4 or 8 groups, and everyone plays everyone within their group. The group winners, optionally also the runners-up, advance to the knockout round. Players from the same group avoid meeting again right away. From 6 players, at least 3 per group. Everyone plays everyone once. The table ranks by wins, then head-to-head, leg difference and average. Whoever is on top at the end wins. From 3 players. '
